_meta.description: Recurring, seasonal and limited events of Sword x Staff with schedule, currency, party need and best free-to-play choice; plus the weekly Grand Treasure Hunt calendar from the SOF guides (server day derived from Loong Haven = day 47 = 2026-09-23). null = unknown.

events.name: Grand Treasure Hunt
events.schedule: Every Saturday (first on server day 8, then every 7 days); unique relic on alternate weeks
events.best_f2p_choice: Save on SAVE weeks; buy Lucky Statue or Primal Gem (Level 5) on MUST BUY weeks
events.notes: Five reward Levels (also called floors or stages). About 3,240 Energy clears Levels 1 to 5; a free player gathers about 4,440 in two weeks or 5,640 in three. Level 5 order: left item (unique relic), far right, middle. Reward cycle: Mythic relic box, Lucky Statue, skill shards x180, Primal Gem. Before Loong Haven a free player skips hunts 1 and 3 and takes 2 and 5. Mini-games: Bingo Draw, Lucky Scratch, Feneck's Puzzle [S-85].

events.name: Chaos Invasion
events.schedule: Recurring, starts after a 7-day countdown; alternates Sundays with Void Rift
events.party: 4 recommended: 1 damage dealer + 3 supports, rotate over 4 runs
events.best_f2p_choice: Buy only the Primal Forge from the Mysterious Merchant until maxed; otherwise dismiss him and save crystals
events.notes: Ranking is per class. Rank 1: 30 Primal Forge Shards, 20 Covenite, 20 Legendary Auroral Badges, 200 Chaos Crystals; rank 501+: 8 Covenite, 100 Chaos Crystals. Boss has very low armor. Companions not allowed.

events.name: Void Rift
events.schedule: Every other Sunday, alternating with Chaos Invasion; 24-hour window, 10 attempts
events.best_f2p_choice: Use all 10 reward attempts in a group; aim for floors 3-5
events.notes: Up to 5 floors; next floor decided by a roll; relic rewards up to Mythic.

events.name: Wheel of Destiny
events.schedule: Any time with Lucky Tickets; one free spin per map wheel while its zone is unexplored
events.best_f2p_choice: Priority: Skill Shard Vouchers > Gateway Keys and Auroral Elemental Badges > Legendary Auroral Badges, Covenite, Bond Trinkets > Legendary Fantomon resources, 2888 Dawnium, extra Lucky Tickets
events.notes: Lucky Ticket in Guild Shop: 1.5K Guild Tokens, limit 1 per week.

events.name: Daily Sign-in
events.schedule: Daily, 30-tile calendar; reset 8:00 UTC-5
events.best_f2p_choice: Claim today's tile; never Catch Up

events.name: Growth Trial
events.schedule: First 19 days
events.best_f2p_choice: Claim free trial quests; never Advanced Trial

events.name: Dawnstar Prelude
events.schedule: Featured card in Thrilling Events

events.name: Pilgrimage (battle pass)
events.schedule: Normal passes and rotating Season passes; 70 tiers
events.best_f2p_choice: Free lane only; do not buy the pass or skip tiers (100 Dawnium per tier)
events.notes: 70 tiers; 16 Normal and 4 Season passes; buying the premium lane later pays out the tiers already passed; Season pass headline is a chosen Legendary Fantomon [S-80]. Free-lane rewards not listed.

events.name: Journey Overture
events.schedule: 19 May to 1 June 2026 (launch)
events.best_f2p_choice: 14-day sign-in (Visage: Salted Splash), free quests, exchange shop
events.notes: Parts: Overture Sign-In, Outfit, Shuffle, Prize Punch, Shop, Packs.

events.name: Haunted Carnival
events.schedule: Seen running to 14 November 2026 on our server
events.notes: Halloween event; Mall packs are paid.

events.name: Voice of Kanstein: Live Everywhere
events.schedule: 19 May to 2 June 2026, 13:00 UTC (web event)

events.name: KonoSuba collaboration
events.schedule: Live 5 June 2026

events.name: Molly's Deals
events.schedule: Weekly, up to 10 purchases; found through the friends list (orange house mark)
events.best_f2p_choice: Check through the week; discounted Stellatie, Covenite, relic gacha badges
